criteria.text: Writer-shaped/current/legacy/flat/foreign archive controls pass: replacement18 scripts.log T24-production-backup-scan-restore through T24-foreign-renamed, 13 PASS/0 FAIL.
Canonical menu states and current dimmed settings presentation are retained in docs/es-menu-map.md and #527's composed standard frame proof.

On the next installed candidate, retain paired640×480 offered `<DEVICE>, <DATE>` and foreign-only disabled-row frames, with exact same-model/foreign fixture inventories, selected archive/journal and unchanged foreign-case settings hashes. Bind to the image/source manifest.
Publish the same-model/newest/disabled-state explanation with #344/#511 release/setup documentation; cite the retrieved page or docs change.

Source-cited diagnosis/disposition cites retained first-failure logs and an agent-run reproduction or an explicit evidence-backed alternative; the SMMU observation is not conflated with SDL readiness.

If a readiness defect and remedy are confirmed, retain the original failing control and corrected/default/late/unavailable readiness outcomes with original exit results, proving no unbounded wait or hidden restart loop. Otherwise retain the evidence-backed alternate or no-change disposition and explain why a correction is not warranted.
Affected startup/upgrade/first-frame timing and presentation evidence is bound to exact source; canonical flow and frames are updated if behavior/presentation changes.

Required Nova physical boot timing is explicitly scoped and recorded in device-facts with named action authority, or remains clearly identified as a hardware observation rather than invented VM proof.
Recorded policy and executable derivation produce distinct same-day identities and consistent semantic versions/timestamp/hash/GitHub naming; retained control output proves it.

Image assembly, banners and information script use the new identity; actual package staging proves fresh-install defaults are unchanged. Exact-source information frames and canonical flow reference record the display change.

Release preparation uses an explicit immutable bundle, validates identity and checksums, and returns the matching GitHub tag/title and exact assets without publishing or overwriting anything. Wrong/stale inputs fail in retained controls. Actual publication remains #265/#528.
Next assembled candidate verifies installed identity and filenames, clean and retained-storage behavior, and source-bound information frames. Runtime-overlay proof alone does not tick this criterion.

Choose a documented valid bcdDevice revision source independent of semantic release text, preserving vendor/product/serial identity; retained controls cover old calendar metadata and current semantic/prerelease metadata.
Source trace and executable guest proof show a valid four-digit BCD value at the configfs write without changing normal USB modes; record exact source and remaining physical observation explicitly.
The next assembled candidate includes the correction and its installed-byte proof before claiming the USB path qualified.
New decided row, active RC acceptance and M7 priority name the exact20261001commit; old freeze statements are superseded or explicitly historical, with sweep evidence.
Integration source has20261001 as ancestor and retains the existing fork features/newer pins; exact diff, conflict-resolution report and applicable pkgcheck/syntax results are recorded.
Changed build inputs and transitive/native effects are mapped; source custody and licence inventory cover accepted new artifacts, including ABL and FEX dependencies.
Retention/capacity enforcement is operational before any new full cache copy/build; original monitored result channels and disk/RAM/swap/PSI evidence are retained.
New-source clean/upgrade VM qualification and independent audit pass with original artifacts; prior-image receipts are not relabelled.
New H700/SM8550 artifacts pass exact component/native/boot-chain checks and required physical facts before release acceptance; publication remains subject to #528/#344 gates.
A source-bound failing control shows the new function loses the prior runtime on download failure while the accepted predecessor preserves it.

A staged replacement preserves the complete working runtime and library links on download, extraction, validation and activation failure; successful replacement retires superseded runtime only after the new one is usable. Original return codes and before/after manifests prove each case.
Interruption/retry recovery and available-space handling are bounded, and saves/games outside the runtime are unchanged in VM fixtures.
New-source installed VM proof and review are recorded before #563's changed image is accepted. User-facing flow/copy evidence is updated if presentation changes.
Record a source/artifact-bound, value-free inventory separating player username/password/token, developer API identity, and previously retained device settings.
Trace existing Nova sign-in to earlier evidence or explicitly retain unknown origin; never infer a clean image from a successful state-preserving upgrade.
Verify a clean image starts with no personal player account and retained-storage upgrades keep the selected user's account, using disposable VM evidence and unchanged-settings receipts.

Verify public release preflight refuses personal build/runtime credentials; synthetic positive/negative fixtures exercise the guard and final accepted payload is checked. Repair any confirmed leak before publication.
Bind displayed backup/restore dates to their actual local stamp fields and status; distinguish attempted, completed-empty and data-transferring operations using retained logs where available.
Trace the two Recent entries to metadata fields and available setup/copy/restore records; state any remaining unknown origin explicitly.
Inspect exact firmware/default payloads and clean-boot storage for cloud activity stamps, play-history metadata, connection state and QA residue; publish only value-free results.
Exercise the isolation gate with synthetic contaminated and clean payloads; fresh installation has no fabricated activity while upgrade preserves legitimate existing history.

Record source-bound metadata paths and operational-script scope, distinguishing imported library history from firmware-seeded or retained account state. Evidence: accepted source paths above and docs/qa-logs/2026-10-13-nova-library-copy.md.

Include a synthetic library-copy case in #565 VM qualification: ROM-only versus ROM-plus-gamelist.xml, expected Recent behavior, and unchanged account/activity-stamp state. Retain source-bound fixture results.

Record the owner-selected interim JELOS developer identity and separate replacement work into #586 (D-WORKFLOW-166). This records the project decision, not new provider authorization or completed provisioning.

Implement and document the selected interim developer provisioning route and applicable artifact checks; reconcile current runtime-only comments and historical guard descriptions under D-WORKFLOW-166. Preserve unrelated private-credential protections; prove actual checks execute.
Implement approved release provisioning without requiring ordinary players to enter developer credentials; keep their own account login distinct and preserve working runtime fallback as appropriate.
Review English/French accounts/options/error flows at small/large sizes, update canonical IA/menu/flow references and source-bound frames, and verify clean/upgrade plus credential backup exclusions.
Inventory exact entry-row/help/confirmation/progress text in the accepted ES pin and its flow/frame reference; establish whether the advance-explanation gap still exists.

If needed, revise existing copy to explain that newly added games will be prepared for offline achievements when that feature is enabled, matching actual indexing/connectivity gates without implying every library update redownloads everything.
Verify disabled/enabled, online/offline, and new/no-new game branches with source-bound VM receipts; preserve behavior and responsiveness.

Update English/French strings, canonical menu/IA/flow reference and reviewed 640x480/1280x800 frames in the same change. If current copy already meets the request, close with exact-source reviewed-frame evidence instead.
Source-bound comparison identifies relevant changes and earliest supported good/bad evidence, retaining uncertain attribution.
Sanitized load/log observations distinguish browser, input bridge and resource/network candidates without exposing authentication contents.
Reproduce any confirmed software defect with a synthetic VM fixture, repair it and retain reviewed flow/frame and timing evidence; otherwise record a watch item with a concrete next observation.
Trace status lifecycle and separate page loading from a genuine control-session failure; preserve useful feedback on real failure.
Fixed header glyph has accessible state text, readable long-name truncation and stable keyboard/control positions through transitions.
Synthetic navigation, failure/reconnect and ended-session controls verify behavior; reviewed narrow/wide EN/FR frames and canonical flow/IA references accompany source changes.
Verify input and touch/pointer behavior remain usable, with no extra scrolling or focus loss introduced by status updates.
Recipe keeps the required controller library and scanner; pkgcheck and real package install controls retain their exact outputs.

VM original-failure and supplied-payload success controls demonstrate plugin loading with a fresh registry (original rc1; exact target library/helper rc0). Actual corrected-package proof remains in the recipe criterion.
Bounded browser comparison records389.1MiB peak PSS, reviewed loaded frame, zero GStreamer warnings and original exit0; it does not resolve #570 or prove the unmodified recipe repaired.
Next assembled image verifies the installed dependency closure, including fresh and retained-state qualification.
Canonical engineering instructions require early checks of upstream issue reports, release notes and relevant fixes, recording date, affected versions and source links in the investigation issue.
Instructions distinguish a similar report from a reproduced match and verify whether a candidate fix is included in the pinned source; they preserve local reproduction and regression checks.
AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md carry the same short rule and link to the canonical detail; tools/rules-check and tools/register-check pass.
The decision register and dated work log record the maintainer's instruction; tools/work-log-index --check passes.
Record source and installed-artifact evidence for standalone/core selection, RA compile support, launch configuration and relevant runtime gates without credentials.
Trace GameCube recognition through ES/offline indexing separately from Dolphin in-game support, including the reported format and a supported test fixture.
Reproduce any confirmed defect in a disposable VM; repair it with source-bound regression evidence, or document a verified upstream/format limitation with accurate player guidance.
Record the disposition and any necessary flow/screenshot documentation; distinguish absent sets, unmatched ROMs and unsupported runtime instead of silently presenting them as equivalent.
Bind the observed systems to selected emulator/core and effective automatic save/load settings; artifact/source receipt separates global preference, runtime implementation, and manager support.

Document and verify behavior for RetroArch, standalone Dolphin and standalone Flycast using disposable VM fixtures: ordinary in-game save, manual state, exit auto-state and manager visibility are separate observations.
If the current UI implies unsupported behavior, correct capability gating or help text with EN/FR flow references and exact-source screenshots; do not silently promise session preservation.

Any proposed standalone integration proves exit/load/slot/path handling, clean and retained-storage behavior, existing state preservation and relevant hardcore restrictions; otherwise record the supported limitation explicitly and scope enhancement separately.

Same-source VM frame sequences show unchanged dialog/list/footer bounds before, during and after initial/refresh scans, with search status within the list area; cover 640×480 and 1280×800, English and French.

The delayed initial scan has an in-list searching state; a delayed refresh preserves the last list and safe focus. Completed zero results and failed scans have distinct outcomes and an actionable retry, proved by fixture transcript and reviewed branch frames.

A long list scrolls within the stable viewport without clipping the buttons; repeat refresh preserves the selected network when present and deterministically selects a valid row when it disappears, proved by input walk and frames.

Repeated refresh, back/exit during a pending scan, late completion and retry do not duplicate jobs, access a destroyed screen or activate stale rows; bounded fixture transcript records the outcome and all worker exits.
Saved/connected/open/protected/unknown/manual-input/profile-choice/forget flows retain their behavior in the VM regression transcript, including no password prompt for confirmed open networks.

Canonical flow/reference and reviewed exact-source happy/branch frame index accompany the final source; syntax checks and affected VM checks pass before pin promotion. Public setup documentation receives the corresponding follow-up.

Bounded VM control distinguishes missing/default, spaced and canonical `favorites,recent` settings; HTTP status and list membership prove the parser/default mismatch, with original failed fixture preserved.

The corrected compiled frontend on a clean configuration exposes the intended default collections; synthetic ROM-only has no Recent entry, while importing matching history creates the expected entry without launching a game.
Explicit retained collection choices are preserved; no forced enablement of a collection the player disabled. Focused regression evidence covers the chosen default/parser repair.
Canonical collection flow/reference and reviewed same-source clean/retained frames accompany the fix; syntax check precedes pin promotion.

Exact-source synthetic failing control records original exits and before/after manifests for failed download/extraction or missing required overlay; distinguish source reasoning from executed reproduction.

Staged validated replacement preserves the prior complete environment and required files on download, extraction, validation, activation and interruption failure; manifests and retry receipts prove it.
Space/time bounds, owned cleanup and recovery are verified without touching Steam games/saves or unrelated FEX roots. Existing intended RootFS refresh remains supported.
Candidate-source installed VM proof and review are linked before #563 acceptance; native execution limits are explicit.
Exact-source synthetic controls retain original exits and manifests for failed download/extraction and incomplete existing destination.

Stage and validate the requested variant before activation or retirement; failures/interruption preserve the usable previous variant and successful replacement has a validated manifest/required payload.
Retry and space/time bounds use one owned staging area, respect distinct Proton families and preserve all game/save/client data; receipts prove cleanup scope.
Candidate-source installed VM proof and review are linked before #563 acceptance; native Proton/Steam usability is separately identified.
Reproduce and preserve the original source's retained-directory failure in an allocated disposable fixture; bind both exact launcher sources and file/type/hash inventories.

Repair preparation so retained real save/state data, existing canonical data, conflicting names and unrelated targets survive. Preserve valid current symlinks, including intentional GameCube/Wii state-link switching. Any ambiguous conversion fails without deleting data and gives an actionable outcome.

Exercise fresh, retained, existing/dangling/unexpected links, conflicts, unavailable/unwritable destination and interrupted preparation; assertions cover original bytes/types, no follow-through deletion and no emulator launch after a refused preparation.

Verify installed script/package identity, clean and retained upgrade paths, and any changed player-facing copy with canonical flow and exact-source frames before promotion. Keep ordinary saves, native states and frontend manager eligibility distinct.

Preserve old-source failed decoder/function exits, before/after manifests and the one deliberate retry showing incomplete state skipped as installed; separately prove valid existing-client preservation.
Missing/incomplete state cannot report installed. Exact-source controls preserve valid client/channel/aliases/custom files and refuse ambiguous existing layouts before writes.

Failure/interruption controls for acquisition, extraction, validation, activation and metadata preserve existing client/SDK and unrelated runtime/FEX/Proton/library/game/save entries. Fresh failure leaves no misleading installed state.
Establish real archive layout and owned paths; verify finite transport/decompression/space limits, owned staging cleanup and deterministic retry. Never replace or delete the whole Steam root.

Review repaired full-caller fresh, retained and allowed-alias VM receipts against exact source; record installed-image, native ARM64/self-update/quiescence and power-loss limits explicitly before closure.
Source report binds the exact proxy pin/local patches and current upstream comparison; identifies the RVZ discovery/hash/cache path and any actual missing adaptation.
A minimal repair, or evidence that none is needed, has synthetic VM regression proof for recognized RVZ and malformed/unsupported cases without changing existing offline behavior.
#574's combined frontend/proxy qualification explicitly references that evidence and retains any remaining Dolphin gameplay limitation.
Canonical engineering instructions require consideration of upstream contributions; decision and rule checks pass.

Each independently useful fix records its upstream target and minimal patch/test requirements, with #585 owning post-build submission follow-up or an explicit duplicate/already-fixed/fork-specific disposition. Submission itself is deferred under D-WORKFLOW-165 and is not a product qualification gate.
Exact source/current-upstream comparison and raw-setting/listener contract are recorded, including explicit contribution disposition.
A minimal launcher change routes only the enabled, non-hardcore, verified-listener case and preserves fallback customhost behavior.

Synthetic VM full-script controls cover toggle0/1, hardcore0/1/empty/unknown, customhost empty/nonempty, IPv4/mapped IPv6/IPv6-only/unreadable tables, missing token and disabled achievements; receipt verifies generated INI and unchanged input settings.
Installed dependency/service and Dolphin host interpretation are verified; distinguish configuration proof from full offline login/cache/award/reconnect behavior.
Canonical flow/limitations and combined #574/#583 qualification reflect the tested behavior before the next candidate.
A bounded no-NIC VM fixture controls connectivity across the startup probe and first worker probe; original probe/queue/peer traces show whether the suspected missed transition occurs.

If reproduced, exact-source correction delivers the queued signed award once when connectivity returns in that window, with original native/service result0 and SQLite integrity/queue receipts. Otherwise record why the hypothesis was disproved.
Already-online, persistent-offline, ordinary reconnect, authentication refusal and stop/restart preserve expected queue/account behavior; no timer bypass or real account/provider required.
Installed composed-source service proof covers the accepted repair before the next candidate is designated; upstream contribution disposition is recorded under #585 after initial build.
Preserve the original seven failures and exact source/process evidence in a compact published packet; identify exited adopted children separately from live work.
Correct observation-time reaping without consuming the active Popen wait or signaling live descendants; preserve original adopted wait statuses and normal cleanup evidence.
Read PL-016 waiting prose from the current status-message element with the historical-template fallback; retain the assertion that the text is nonempty and does not name an absent button.

Run the existing scripts row on the same frozen image under a fresh watched owner; retain its original PASS result and actual owner cleanup. Carry the other successful same-image standard rows without repeating them. Complete the separately pending SFTP and local S3 rows under #344.
Source/spec/provenance map and running log identify the exact frozen delta and every applicable criterion, with prior verdicts sequestered during independent forward review.
Independent forward and interaction reviews cite primary source/receipts, attempt refutation and distinguish unrun dependencies from confirmed failures.
Both verified cross-lab passes are preserved through the Facilitator; every finding is checked against actual source or executable evidence.
Required audit artifacts/lints and punch list are complete; confirmed candidate-blocking defects are repaired and verified before RC designation. Original failed evidence remains unchanged.
